name: synthetic-churn-uc1
description: Small synthetic B2B-SaaS churn dataset for UC-1 native tests. No real customer data, no foreign runtime. Includes the Contoso entity-resolution case (TC-4): Contoso Freight + 5 sibling subsidiaries as separate accounts.
label_definition: churned == true iff the account canceled / did not renew within churn_horizon_days after as_of_date (churn_date falls in (as_of, as_of+H]).
